t: You're on Camberwell Grove, a residential street in Camberwell, in the Borough of Southwark. It follows the line of a grove of trees, which is where the name comes from. The street once led from a Tudor manor house south to the top of a hill, with a view of the City of London about three miles to the north. Today it sits in a conservation area. The painter David Hepher lived here. He is best known for his paintings of buildings and tower blocks, including the Aylesbury Estate.
